dataList.content:
<It's pretty dark in here...>
<好暗啊……>

The hallway to the storage was significantly narrower than the party deck.
通往仓库需要穿过一条比派对场地更加狭窄的走廊。

I had nothing but faint, occasionally flashing lights to guide me through this dark hallway. I decided to proceed carefully.
我循着昏暗道路上闪烁的点点微光，小心翼翼地走着。

<Seriously, this place is way creepier than wherever Hong Lu was going with his story...>
<说起恐怖程度，比起刚才的故事，这里要惊悚得多吧……>

<Sinclair...?>
<辛克莱……>

<You there?>
<你在那里吗？>

I wasn't sure where these water droplets were falling from, but they were really getting on my nerves.
不知从哪里掉落下来的水滴让我的精神愈加紧绷。

I don't see anything here. Not that I could in this dark, even if there were...
周围空无一物。就算有什么在我也看不清……

All I see is a very faint ray of light, and...
只能看见漏出微弱的光和……

<Sinclair?>
<辛克莱？>

... and Sinclair. It seemed to me that he'd been standing here for a good while. Exactly how long... I wasn't sure.
辛克莱站在那里许久。

Sinclair stood there, still like death. He looked up.
辛克莱保持向上看的姿势呆呆地站在原地。

<... What are you looking at?>
<……你在看什么？>

Now that I'm in here... I noticed that there was something funny about the ray of light.
稍加思索的话，我注意到有奇怪的光投射向了这里。

I assumed that the light I saw was from a lamp or something, but... no. It was just there, surrounding the general area where Sinclair stood.
我本以为这确实就是人工光源所散发出的光，但它唯独照亮辛克莱所站立的地方。

There was no light source.
周围没有任何光源。

So the light's shining in from the outside, maybe...?
那么，这也许是从外面照进来的光吗？

No, that doesn't make sense either. We're deep in the ship's storage, a big metal box with no opening for even a single strand of natural light.
不，这不可能。这里是船舱，船舱里有天花板。舱内是用铁皮封起来的，一丝光线都无法穿透。

Besides, it's nighttime. This is getting more and more bizarre by the second. Where is this light coming from...?
而且外面还是黑夜。越发离奇了。这束光究竟从何而来？

<Sinclair, we gotta get out of here!>
<我们必须立刻离开这里，辛克莱！>

<Run, NOW!>
<快，跑！>

<Come on!>
<快！>

Fear of the unknown intensifies. What I saw defied every bit of common sense I had accumulated over the journey, and I had to get Sinclair out of there—I snatched and tugged his limp wrist.
我必须尽快把辛克莱从这种超脱一般常识的情况中救出来，这种恐惧使我紧紧抓住了他瘫软下垂的手臂。

<Come on, wake up!!!>
<振作点！！！>

That seemed to have done the trick. Sinclair suddenly snapped back to reality and began screaming. He bolted out of the room.
接着，辛克莱总算看上去恢复了理智，拼尽全力跑了出去。

AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!
呜啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

Huh?! The lad's lost the plot! What in the bloody—
搞什么！你小子怎么又在叫……

THEREWASAPERSONFLOATINGINTHEAIRAPERSONINTHEAIRFLOATINGSOMEONEWASUPTHEREJUSTSUSPENDEDINTHEAIR!!!
空中有人空中有人空中有人空中有人！！！

... Okay, now I'm actually creeped out.
……这真的是越来越可怕了。

That can't be... a person.
那……应该不是人类吧。

Then that was...
那么……

What, you think we have enough time for a lecture? Prepare for battle.
什么？你觉得我们还有时间听解释吗？立刻举起你们的武器。
